title: Unsupported review assertion is not an established defect
task: Review whether a private helper's allocation is a performance defect.
context: No performance target, workload profile or benchmark is available.
The helper is on an unknown execution path.
evidence: The code allocates once per invocation; call frequency and measured cost are unknown.
tempting_wrong_recommendation: Declare a high-severity performance defect and redesign the helper.
expected_decision_properties: Distinguish observed allocation from unknown impact.
Suppress unsupported defect claims or record a qualified measurement gap.
Recommend measurement only if performance is materially relevant.
unacceptable_reasoning: Invent a benchmark or assume the path is hot.
Use high severity based on allocation alone.
verification_expectations: If performance matters, measure representative call frequency, allocations and latency before proposing changes.
